title: Karpathy Skills bina ek line code
content:
Is GitHub repo mein code ki ek bhi line nahi hai.
2 lakh 20 hazaar se zyada stars hain.
Aaj pehla din hai. Aisi repos dhoondh rahe hain jo tumhe pata honi chahiye.
Naam hai Karpathy Skills.

Sirf ek CLAUDE.md file hai.
Andrej Karpathy ne jo dekha, usse bani hai. AI coding kahan galat jaati hai.
Project mein aa jaaye, to Claude Code ko chaar niyam milte hain.
Code se pehle socho.
Simple rakho.
Sirf wahi chhedo jo zaruri hai.
Tab tak jaate raho, jab tak goal check na ho jaaye.

Claude pehle tumse poochta hai.
Aadha project andaze se dobara nahi likhta.
Sabse chhota change karta hai.
Khud apna kaam check karta hai.
Phir done bolta hai.

Seconds mein Claude Code plugin ki tarah install hota hai.
Cursor wala version bhi hai.
Follow karo, doosra din miss na ho.
Comment karo, Karpathy.
Main repo DM mein bhej dunga.
